the IoT technologies can be applied to industrial automation domain with the help of some technical solutions.
industrial automation is a domain with unique constraints, which requires unique solutions, and that the IoT paradigm is not sufficient to address the challenges of this domain.
the industrial Internet of Things is an emerging technology with a lot of potential for industrial automation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: 1) what are the specific quality attribute requirements for industrial automation?
the following two research questions: (RQ1) How to enable scalable, reliable, and collaborative industrial automation with IoT?

how to utilize IoT for industrial automation to achieve the following: (1) scalable and reliable collaboration between heterogeneous devices; (2) reliable and predictable real-time closed-loop automation; (3) inclusion of intelligent service from edge devices to cloud; (4) efficient data management and analytics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
IoT can be applied to the industrial automation domain to achieve intelligent and collaborative automation.
industrial IoT is not just a matter of applying the IoT paradigm to the industrial domain, but requires a new approach that is tailored to the specific needs of this domain.

the IoT technologies can indeed be used in industrial automation domain, and the IoT technologies can provide a new way of thinking and a new set of technical solutions to address the challenges of industrial automation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the industrial automation domain has unique constraints and requirements for the IoT, which should be considered in the design of the IoT systems and solutions.
industrial automation is a domain that is very suitable for the application of industrial IoT, and that industrial IoT has the potential to bring significant benefits to industrial automation.

the IoT technology is ready to support industrial automation, and the industrial automation domain is ready to adopt the IoT technology, and the two domains can mutually benefit each other in the future.
The main takeaway from our work is that
IoT is an enabler for industrial automation, but there are still many technical challenges that need to be addressed.
, to make IoT a success in industrial automation, we need to develop a new breed of industrial automation systems that are able to support the new requirements and features brought by IoT.
industrial automation requires a different set of technical solutions to cope the IoT challenges, and that the existing IoT technical solutions are not directly applicable for industrial IoT.
